answer_1.quote: We formulate this problem as a streaming video-to-dialogue generation task.

answer_2.quote: For systematic evaluation, we propose two complementary automatic metrics: a pairwise approach based on sentence matching and an end-to-end approach utilizing LLM-as-a-Judge.

answer_3.quote: we propose using LLMs to directly assess the quality of the overall assistance experience. Given timestamped predictions and reference dialogues, we prompt an LLM to evaluate system performance across four dimensions: correctness of guidance and feedback, appropriateness of response timing, efficiency of information delivery, and overall helpfulness.

answer_4.quote: We uniformly sampled 100 dialogues from the test split across all six data subsets, covering three user types. Two annotators evaluated each dialogue along four dimensions...
answer_4.guideline: 4-point Likert scale (1=bad, 2=fair, 3=good, 4=excellent) for correctness, helpfulness, alignment, and naturalness
